name: motion-launch-videos
description: Short looping launch videos made in code, in eight styles, each its own skill: kinetic type, flat shape animation, cartoons, 3D type and logos, data charts, pixel art, particles and app UI demos. Claude writes each film as one self-contained HTML canvas file driven by a pure seek(t), checks it with an automated critique, and renders it to MP4, GIF and poster with real motion blur and a verified seamless loop.
